digest.component_or_area: janitor plan recovery and RP-02–RP-06 derisk
propositions: Five approved-but-lossy recovery proposals (RP-02 through RP-06) require evidence-backed decision-ready briefs before becoming implementation stories to preserve prior architectural intent and resolve implementation-critical ambiguities.

RP-02 transaction semantics mandate ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary where durable tombstone, forward, and reverse identities must exactly agree for recovery to succeed, with repeat being a no-op and ambiguity safety-aborting.

RP-03 outbound lifecycle protocol requires singular retry ownership with maximum 3 physical invocations, 15 seconds cumulative sleep, and a scoped three-consecutive exhausted-outcomes fuse across at least 2 tickets per endpoint family, while commit_unknown and re-observation preserve Jira write safety.

RP-04 operation snapshot and configuration composition must enforce explicit CLI-over-environment-over-project-over-user-over-default precedence with fail-closed malformed-config behavior and separate secret/provider boundaries during cutover.

RP-05 CLI registry and capability boundary require a decision on whether to normalize all 21 visible advanced verbs onto side-effect-free package-data help now or preserve the current two-family help policy.

RP-06 plan-review policy ownership and effective applicability must honor project criteria selection/inclusion/exclusion provenance and fail-closed transient-failure checkpoint handling while distinguishing failed from succeeded-with-zero-findings states.
